Tragic hero | A tragic hero is the protagonist of a tragedy in drama.  In his "Poetics", Aristotle records the descriptions of the tragic hero to the playwright and strictly defines the place that the tragic hero must play and the kind of man he must be.  Aristotle based his observations on previous dramas.  Many of the most famous instances of tragic heroes appear in Greek literature, most notably the works of Sophocles and Euripides.
Tragic hero (disambiguation) | A tragic hero is the protagonist of a tragedy.
Germanic hero | A Germanic hero is the protagonist of certain works of early medieval literature mostly in Germanic languages.  This hero is always a warrior, concerned both with his reputation and fame, and with his political responsibilities.  The way in which he "copes with the blows of fate" is extremely important.  He may be distinguished from the classical hero in that his adventures are less individualistic, and from the tragic hero because his death is heroic rather than tragic.  His death usually brings destruction, not restoration, as in tragedy.  His goal is frequently revenge, "hamartia" in a tragic hero.  The historical era with which the Germanic heroes of the literature are associated in legend is called the Germanic Heroic Age.
List of horror film villains | The following is an alphabetical list of horror film villains.  These range from intelligent and cunning antagonists such as Hannibal Lecter or It/ Pennywise, through to unstable killers who tend to strike randomly out of sheer compulsion (e.g. Leatherface or Buffalo Bill), and including monstrous creatures and killer animals (Graboids, Cujo, etc). Bulandi (2000 film) | Bulandi is a Bollywood action family drama film, a remake of the Tamil movie "Nattamai".  In "Bulandi", Anil Kapoor portrays the protagonist, with Rekha and Raveena Tandon in supporting roles.  Rajinikanth plays the father of the protagonist,respiring his role from Tollywood Film "Pedarayudu".  Anil Kapoor enacts the role of the head of the village.  The story revolves around the environment of a village under the Panchayati Raj rule.  The hero's family brings justice to the village. " Nattamai" was also made in Kannada "(Simhadriya Simha)" starring Vishnuvardhan.
Vaapsi | Vaapsi (ਵਾਪਸੀ) is an upcoming drama film, Punjabi film directed by Rakesh Mehta and starring Harish Verma, Sameksha, Dhrriti Saharan and Gulshan Grover as the main protagonists of the film.  This film is about a young probable hockey player, Ajit Singh, who gets trapped in a tragic situation during the dark days of Punjab.  The trailer of the movie was released on 13 April 2016.  The release date of the film is 3 June 2016.

Vaapsi | Vaapsi (ਵਾਪਸੀ) is an upcoming drama film, Punjabi film directed by Rakesh Mehta and starring Harish Verma, Sameksha, Dhrriti Saharan and Gulshan Grover as the main protagonists of the film.  This film is about a young probable hockey player, Ajit Singh, who gets trapped in a tragic situation during the dark days of Punjab.  The trailer of the movie was released on 13 April 2016.  The release date of the film is 3 June 2016.
